newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - gas oil up $4, fuel up $3.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gas oil up $4, fuel up $3.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly stronger or steady on Tuesday, traders said.
Gasoline barges were stable but cargoes eased, with Eurograde offers seen at $204 cif NWE.
Naphtha held onto strength seen on Monday, when an Egyptian cargo was traded at a five-year record of $216 cif NWE.
Gas oil gained around $4 with futures strength but physical premiums came under pressure with signs of growing supply.
High sulphur cracked barges firmed by nearly $3 on Tuesday trading up to $110 fob ARA.
